newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT cuts 1997 capex to 24.6 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: PLDT cuts 1997 capex to 24.6 bln pesos.

text.p: Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co (PLDT) said on Monday it had lowered its budgeted capital expenditure for this year to 24.6 billion pesos from 29.2 billion.

The company spent 11.4 billion pesos for capital equipment in the first six months of the year, lower than the budgeted 16.9 billion earmarked for the period, PLDT executive vice president Edgardo del Fonso told analysts and reporters.
Del Fonso said delays by contractors prompted the company to lower its expenditure budget.
He added that the original budget was prepared in August and September last year.
Del Fonso said the company's full-year installation target of 204,000 new lines will not be affected by the lowering of expenses.
PLDT installed 52,315 lines in the first half of the year.
